candidates.name: dockge
candidates.description: A fancy, easy-to-use and reactive self-hosted docker compose.yaml stack-oriented manager
candidates.score_reason: Docker Compose UI réactive TypeScript, gestion stacks visuelle, indispensable pour homelab moderne.

candidates.name: Infisical – open-source secrets manager
candidates.description: Infisical is the open-source platform for secrets, certificates, and privileged access management.
candidates.score_reason: Secrets management crucial self-hosted. Stack TypeScript/CLI parfait. Souveraineté numérique directe.

candidates.name: Ollama – Run LLMs on your Mac
candidates.description: Get up and running with Kimi, GLM, MiniMax, DeepSeek, gpt-oss, Qwen, Gemma and other models.
candidates.score_reason: Runtime LLM local incontournable, bien maintenu, compatible Docker/self-hosting. Essentiel.

candidates.name: Coroot – eBPF-based, open source observability with actionable insights
candidates.description: Coroot is an open-source observability and APM tool with AI-powered Root Cause Analysis. It combines metrics, logs, traces, continuous profiling, and SLO-based alerting with predefined dashboards and inspections.
candidates.score_reason: APM+logs+traces unifiés, RCA IA. Stack TypeScript/Go align parfait. Vraie alternative Datadog self-hosted.

candidates.name: beszel
candidates.description: Lightweight server monitoring with historical data, docker stats, and alerts.
candidates.score_reason: Monitoring léger Go, historique, Docker stats, alertes : pile ce qu'il faut pour homelab.

candidates.name: dokku
candidates.description: A docker-powered PaaS that helps you build and manage the lifecycle of applications
candidates.score_reason: PaaS Docker léger Go, déploiement simplifié, exactement souveraineté + DevOps perso.

candidates.name: HyperDX – open-source dev-friendly Datadog alternative
candidates.description: Resolve production issues, fast. An open source observability platform unifying session replays, logs, metrics, traces and errors powered by ClickHouse and OpenTelemetry.
candidates.score_reason: Observabilité complète (replay+metrics+traces), ClickHouse performant. Solide pour infra perso/pro Rust.

candidates.name: CLI tool for saving web pages as a single file
candidates.description: ⬛️ CLI tool and library for saving complete web pages as a single HTML file
candidates.score_reason: Rust + archivage web autonome = souveraineté numérique pure. Parfait self-hosting mindset.

candidates.name: dashy
candidates.description: 🚀 A self-hostable personal dashboard built for you. Includes status-checking, widgets, themes, icon packs, a UI editor and tons more!
candidates.score_reason: Dashboard Vue personnalisable, widgets riches, UI editor intuitif, stack compatible.

candidates.name: uptime-kuma
candidates.description: A fancy self-hosted monitoring tool
candidates.score_reason: Monitoring mainstream, JavaScript, très mature, parfait pour surveiller infra perso/pro.

candidates.name: A CLI tool I made to self-host any app with two commands on a VPS
candidates.description: Bare metal to production ready in mins; your own fly server on your VPS.
candidates.score_reason: Self-host production-ready attire. VPS + DevOps daily. Mais concurrent direct à alternatives établies.

candidates.name: Pangolin – Open source alternative to Cloudflare Tunnels
candidates.description: Modern networking and security platform providing secure access and connectivity to apps, infrastructure, and AI workloads. Connect and protect your users.
candidates.score_reason: Gateway sécurisé, NAT-traversal, self-hosting — parfait souveraineté numérique + infra perso.

candidates.name: Trench – Open-source analytics infrastructure
candidates.description: Trench — Open-Source Analytics Infrastructure. A single production-ready Docker image built on ClickHouse, Kafka, and Node.js for tracking events. Easily build product analytics dashboards, LLM RAGs, observability platforms, or any other analytics product.
candidates.score_reason: Stack moderne (TS, Docker, ClickHouse). Self-hosting analytics pertinent. Moins original qu'attendu.

candidates.name: Tailsnitch – A security auditor for Tailscale
candidates.description: A security auditor for Tailscale configurations. Scans your tailnet for misconfigurations, overly permissive access controls, and security best practice violations.
candidates.score_reason: Tailscale power user? Oui. Utile quotidien? Non. Niche mais solide audit tool.

candidates.name: Linux server monitoring web dashboard
candidates.description: A beautiful web dashboard for Linux
candidates.score_reason: Dashboard Linux élégant, parfait self-hosting perso. Maintenance stable mais feature-light pour DevOps avancé.

candidates.name: Find the best local LLM for your hardware, ranked by benchmarks
candidates.description: Find the local LLM that actually runs and performs best on your hardware. Ranked by real, recency-aware benchmarks, not parameter count. One command, run it instantly.
candidates.score_reason: Benchmarks utiles pour choisir son LLM local, mais interface web plutôt que CLI/API.

candidates.name: Tracecat – Open-source security alert automation / SOAR alternative
candidates.description: Open-source security automation platform for teams and AI agents
candidates.score_reason: Incident response automation intéressant. Stack Python lourd. Overkill pour perso.

candidates.name: Online database diagram editor
candidates.description: Free, simple, and intuitive online database diagram editor and SQL generator.
candidates.score_reason: Bon outil, mais peu original. Utile pour schémas DB, limité par interface web vs local-first preference.

candidates.name: Rivet – Open-source game server management with Nomad and Rust
candidates.description: Rivet Actors are the primitive for stateful workloads. Built for AI agents, collaborative apps, and durable execution.
candidates.score_reason: Rust + actors intéressant, mais cloud-centric (Cloudflare). Moins pertinent pour self-hosting souverain.

candidates.name: Cactus – Ollama for Smartphones
candidates.description: Quantization, kernels, runtime and inference engine for mobiles, wearables, smart home and robots.
candidates.score_reason: Edge AI intéressant (IoT/domotique), mais focus mobile/ARM limite utilité quotidienne dev.

candidates.name: Killport – CLI tool to kill processes running on a specified port
candidates.description: A command-line tool to kill processes and containers running on specified ports.
candidates.score_reason: Utile en CLI terminal, mais cas d'usage étroit. Rust bonus, impact quotidien limité.

candidates.name: Nxtscape – an open-source agentic browser
candidates.description: 🌐 The open-source Agentic browser; alternative to ChatGPT Atlas, Perplexity Comet, Dia.
candidates.score_reason: Agent browser intéressant philosophiquement, mais IA locale + souveraineté tension. Immaturité perçue.

candidates.name: OpenLLMetry – OpenTelemetry-based observability for LLMs
candidates.description: Open-source observability for your GenAI or LLM application, based on OpenTelemetry
candidates.score_reason: Niche LLM observability. Utile si vous déployez GenAI localement, sinon peu pertinent quotidien.

candidates.name: A terminal emulator in pure PHP
candidates.description: A terminal renderer written in pure PHP.
candidates.score_reason: Terminal renderer PHP original mais niche. Peu d'utilité concrète pour workflow dev senior Rust/TS.

candidates.name: Iota – a text editor written in Rust
candidates.description: A terminal-based text editor written in Rust
candidates.score_reason: Éditeur terminal Rust intéressant mais hors catégorie IoT/Domotique demandée.

candidates.name: I made open source, zero power PCB hackathon badges
candidates.description: NFC hackathon badges for the Overglade game jam in Singapore!
candidates.score_reason: Badges NFC pour hackathon spécifique. Hors contexte perso/pro, maintenance incertaine.
